voice.name: Open Sector - Heavy Assimilator
voice.note: Shares the Heavy Assimilator voice designed for the Stalker (voices/stalker.json); slower delivery for the biggest machine.
voice.description: Enormous, slow machine voice of a giant legged alien war machine of a cyborg hive: very deep sub-bass layered voice, as if several huge synthetic voices speak at once an octave apart, grinding metallic overtones and a rumbling engine-like drone beneath every word, cold, emotionless and inevitable, each word heavy and deliberate with long pauses.

fire.prompt: Distant, massive double boom of two enormous energy disruptor cannons firing together on an open battlefield: a colossal deep electric blast, heavy crackling discharge and a long thundering rolling echo, no music, no voice

move.prompt: Colossal legged alien war machine taking two enormous slow ground-shaking steps: very deep metallic thuds, massive hydraulic pistons groaning and hissing, heavy servo grind, the ground rumbling, close, no music, no voice

die.prompt: Colossal legged alien war machine destroyed: a huge deep explosion with massive electric arcs discharging, a giant synthetic drone groaning down in pitch, huge steel frame tearing apart and crashing to the ground with a long rumble, medium distance outdoors, no music, no voice
